findings.label: verification.md "only file I changed" overstates
findings.detail: The note claims the hook is the only file changed, but the working tree also carries unrelated .gitignore and docs/pruebas/vision-general.md edits. Harmless; the claim should be scoped to "the only code file changed for the feature logic."

findings.label: Latent nested-Text inheritance override
findings.detail: The wrapper injects an absolute fontSize (14x factor when none is set) on every Text, which would override RN parent->child text size inheritance for nested <Text>. No nested <Text><Text> exists in the app today (grep found none), so no current regression; add a code comment for future authors.

findings.label: On-device behavior unverified
findings.detail: Correctness rests on code reasoning + typecheck + lint; the connected device runs a release APK that cannot hot-reload the new bundle. Honestly disclosed in verification.md. Static evidence (plus independently reproduced writable-default Babel output) is sufficient to approve; run on a dev build or fresh APK to visually confirm Grande ~15% / Extra ~30% and persistence.
